title: %levenshtein - edit distance between two strings
purpose: Return the minimum single-character edits to turn one string into another.
input:
a = "kitten"
b = "sitting"
same1 = "abc"
same2 = "abc"
empty = ""
word = "abc"
notes: Two required string arguments. Counts insertions, deletions, and substitutions. Returns an integer (## prefix).
